title: The crossmetric tensor and the geometrical meaning of the imaginary numbers
summary: The product of two Cartesian quaternions can be written as a quadratic form based on a 4x4 matrix made of the symbols 1,i,j,k where i,j,k are imaginary numbers introduced by Hamilton. We generalized this matrix to non-Cartesian bases, and showed that the matrix is made of the metric and the cross tensors. We called it crossmetric tensor. Its symbols are s,a,b,c; they are the elementary crystallographic quaternions. We determined the crossmetric tensors for the six crystal families.
